basic_details.job_title: DAO Budgam Krishi Udyami Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited for 04 positions of Krishi Udyami (Agricultural Entrepreneur) to operate vacant Panchayat Level Kisan Khidmat Ghars in District Budgam under the Holistic Agriculture Development Program Phase II, which must be submitted to the Office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam in person or by registered post by 30 October 2026 upto 4:30 PM.

rows.details: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Office of the Chief Agriculture Officer, District Budgam
Self-earning / entrepreneur basis (commission and service charges)
Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields or Graduation in Science / Agriculture & Allied Fields
Designated Panchayats in District Budgam (Jammu & Kashmir)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed application forms prepared in the prescribed format (Annexure A) along with self-attested supporting documents must be submitted offline to: Office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam, District Budgam, Jammu & Kashmir Applications can be delivered by hand in person or forwarded via registered post. Submissions must reach the specified office on or before 30 October 2026 by 4:30 PM. Applications received after the deadline or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected, and the department will not bear responsibility for any postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualifications: Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields or Graduation in Science (BSc), or Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc / BVSc). Diploma courses include: Diploma in Agriculture, Horticulture, Veterinary Sciences, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture, Agri. Engineering, BHT, or BAT from a government-recognised institution. Agriculture Allied courses include: BSc in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture; B.Tech in Agriculture Engineering; or BVSc & AH from a government-recognised institution. Additional preference is given to candidates with post-graduation (science / agriculture & allied) and computer diplomas/certifications of 3 or more months duration from a government-recognised institution. Age Limit: Candidates must be between 21 and 45 years of age as of the last date of submission (30 October 2026). Remuneration & Earnings Model: The position is on a self-earning and entrepreneurship basis operating under a franchise-franchisee framework. Krishi Udyamis earn their livelihood through nominal service charges fixed by Mission Director HADP, commissions on the sale of farm inputs (seeds, fertilizers, pesticides), commissions from facilitating business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) produce marketing, and contingency fees for attending departmental training sessions. Candidates should verify the discipline-specific eligibility from the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents with the completed application form: Date of birth certificate (Matriculation certificate). Marks certificate of all qualifying examinations. Domicile Certificate. Character certificate issued by the competent authority. An affidavit attested by a 1st Class Magistrate stating that the candidate will provide secure space comprising two rooms/shops (approximately 750 to 800 Sq. Ft.) at a feasible location within the concerned Panchayat at their own cost, without claiming any rent. Signed Declaration affirming accuracy of details on a notarized affidavit as per Annexure B. Computer course certificates and higher qualification certificates, if applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for engagement as Krishi Udyami is conducted entirely through a 100-point merit-based system, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted applicants must present all original mark sheets, certificates, and affidavits for verification. The final list of selected candidates will be published on the official websites of the District and the Agriculture Production Department.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under DAO Budgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 04 vacant positions of Krishi Udyami (Agricultural Entrepreneur) across pre-identified Panchayat Level Kisan Khidmat Ghars in District Budgam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of complete applications is 30 October 2026 upto 4:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields, a Graduation in Science (BSc), or a Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc/BVSc), with preference given to postgraduates and computer diploma holders.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Krishi Udyami in Budgam?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 45 years of age as of the last date of application submission (30 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format, either in person or via registered post to the Office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for Krishi Udyami posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based entirely on a 100-point scale evaluating local panchayat domicile, gender, academic qualification, postgraduate degrees, and computer certifications, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of engagement for Krishi Udyamis?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for a period of 2 years on a contract agreement, with the possibility of annual extensions based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any security deposit required upon selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must deposit a refundable security amount of Rs 10,000 as a Fixed Deposit Receipt from any scheduled commercial bank, which is forfeited if they exit before completing two years.

faq.question: Q9. Is accommodation provided by the department for Kisan Khidmat Ghars?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit an affidavit confirming they will make available a secure commercial space of two rooms or shops (approx. 750 to 800 Sq. Ft.) within the Panchayat at their own cost without claiming rent.
